mapper.sql: owner_id, credential_id, credential_hash, status, claimed_by_user_id, created_at, claimed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO anonymous_workspace (owner_id, credential_id, credential_hash, status, claimed_by_user_id, created_at, claimed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{credentialId}, #{credentialHash}, #{status}, #{claimedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{claimedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE anonymous_workspace SET status = 'CLAIMED', claimed_by_user_id = #{claimedByUserId}, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, updated_at = #{claimedAt} WHERE credential_id = #{credentialId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
